newsitem.title: BELGIUM: W.European Jan-July all-freighter traffic up 2.2pc.
newsitem.headline: W.European Jan-July all-freighter traffic up 2.2pc.

text.p: The percentage of global freight traffic shipped by West European airlines on all-cargo aircraft rose by 2.2 percentage points in the first seven months of the year on 1995 levels, the Association of European Airlines (AEA) told Reuters.
Global freight traffic carried by West European airlines in the first seven months of 1996 was up 3.7 percent on the same period last year at 13.29 billion freight tonne-kilometres, FTK, AEA showed.
The FTK measurement is derived by multiplying the weight of cargo carried by the distance flown.
In the period in question, airlines' full-freighter services accounted for 35.9 percent of the global volume of traffic flown compared to 33.7 percent in January-July 1995.
On Europe-Far East/Australasia routes, the volume of traffic transported by full-freighters between January and July this year rose by 2.7 percentage points on 1995 levels to 47.2 percent.
On Europe-North America air cargo routes, the volume of traffic shipped on full freighter services increased by 1.8 percentage points on January-July 1995 levels to 28.1 percent.
